buyerQuestions.question: What should a buyer prepare before asking for custom paper tube packaging?
buyerQuestions.answer: Prepare tube diameter, height, product weight, closure style, cap direction, insert or liner needs, artwork status, print coverage, finish reference, retail channel and target market.

buyerQuestions.question: How should buyers compare paper tube packaging, composite paper cans and eco-friendly tube packaging?
buyerQuestions.answer: Compare product fit, paperboard direction, wall thickness, cap fit, display role, shipment protection, surface finish, document review needs and whether the package is for cosmetics, candles, tea, fragrance, wellness or gift products.

buyerQuestions.question: Why can a page have impressions but no clicks?
